description: Bitwise reference outputs of eda: every case's input regenerates bitwise from tests/python/cases.py; the decomposition must match every hash bit for bit. Made by eda itself (each case decomposed in two separate processes, in opposite orders, with equal results).

hash_conventions.sha256: SHA-256 of the C-order bytes of the array (dtype and shape recorded)
hash_conventions.input_sha256: the input as built by cases.Case.input()
hash_conventions.y_sha256: the public output array (layout of the public API) in C order
hash_conventions.rows_sha256: per output row p: the elements' row p in the computed layout (batch elements in C order, then the spatial axes in the order of axes)
hash_conventions.info: windows, sifts: int32 arrays of info_shape (*batch, K), stored as values in C order when they have at most 64 entries, else as sha256; spacing, energy: float64 arrays of info_shape, as sha256
hash_conventions.sensitivity: the largest change of the public output, relative to max|x| (finite samples), under three probes that move every finite input sample by one unit in the last place in a random direction (NumPy default_rng seeds 0, 1, 2: integers(-1, 2) per sample, nextafter), with every decision unchanged; conditioning_class "sensitive" (sensitivity null) when a probe changes a decision
